messages:
Ellen Park: FYI customer jdoe reported that after the v4.0 rollout some answers include old contract language. They say the model sometimes references 'Legacy SLA 2023' in replies that should reference 'SLA 2026'.
support-bot: created INC-2026-7867 for Ellen Park
customer_jdoe: here is a minimal repro — I call /v1/chat with model=gptx-versa and ask 'What is the current SLA for enterprise tier?' Sometimes reply says 'Legacy SLA 2023: 99.5%' which is wrong. request_ids: c_9f1a, c_9f1b
Ravi Desai: Which deployment is this? Hosted/dedicated/private? Also paste full examples if you have them.
Ellen Park: Hosted, account acct_430. Repro below:
```
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat
Authorization: Bearer sk-c-XXXX
{"model":"gptx-versa","input":"What is the current SLA for enterprise tier?"}

Bad response: \"Legacy SLA 2023 guarantees 99.5% uptime...\"
Expected (v4.0): \"SLA 2026 guarantees 99.9% uptime with x,y,z exceptions...\"
```
Ravi Desai: Pulling runtime traces for acct_430 and those request ids now.
QA Jenkins: Note: v4.0 rollout completed at 2026-03-18T14:02:00Z per deploy-bot
deploy-bot: Deploy gptx-versa:v4.0 -> success at 2026-03-18T14:02:00Z
Ravi Desai: Runtime logs for c_9f1a:
[2026-03-18T14:15:12Z] req=c_9f1a cust=acct_430 model=gptx-versa ver=v4.0 kv_lookup=prefix-acct_430 kv_hit=true key=prefix-acct_430 size=10.8KB
[2026-03-18T14:15:12Z] req=c_9f1a decode_path=v4.0 kernel=attn_v3
Ravi Desai: Key here is prefix-acct_430 — I also see similar keys populated during v3.2 testing earlier. The prefix keying does not include model_version or model_hash.
Ellen Park: Hmm that explains cross-version reuse. If v3.2 populated prefix-acct_430 with decoder cache for older policy text, v4.0 could reuse it producing stale outputs.
Ravi Desai: Confirmed. I ran a quick check across the cluster and found ~27 accounts with kv hits where the stored key metadata version != runtime request version. Generated a small report.
Ravi Desai: sample report snippet:
```
acct_430: stored_version=v3.2, request_version=v4.0, kv_hit_count=3
acct_198: stored_version=v2.9, request_version=v4.0, kv_hit_count=1
acct_512: stored_version=v3.2, request_version=v4.0, kv_hit_count=5
```
Ellen Park: Priority: customer-facing incorrect SLA text got their legal team worried. We should purge acct_430 prefixes and notify the customer. Also need root cause and rollback plan.
Ravi Desai: Purging prefix for acct_430 now via internal admin endpoint. Command:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://admin.redwood.internal/cache/purge" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer admin-xxxx" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"scope":"customer","customer_id":"acct_430","prefix_id":"prefix-acct_430"}'
```
Ravi Desai: Purge returned 200 OK. Log: [2026-03-18T14:22:05Z] purge=req_purge_01 user=ravi scope=customer acct_430 prefix=prefix-acct_430 result=ok
Ellen Park: Re-ran c_9f1a after purge -> response now references SLA 2026. Customer confirmed updated replies are correct.
customer_jdoe: verified with my team — new responses are accurate. Thanks for the fast fix.
Ravi Desai: Root cause: prefix cache keys were tenant-scoped only (prefix-{customer}) and lacked model_name:model_version dimension. v3.2 prefixes were reused with v4.0 decoder leading to stale policy text being surfaced.
Ellen Park: Short-term mitigation applied: 1) purge affected prefixes for impacted customers (done for known hits). 2) deploy hotfix to include model_version in keying. 3) add alert for cross-version kv hits.
Ravi Desai: Hotfix PR created: runtime/PR-4891. Patch excerpt:
```python
# old
key = f\"prefix-{customer_id}\"
# new
key = f\"prefix-{customer_id}:{model_name}:{model_version}\"
```
Ravi Desai: Hotfix rolled to canary at 14:30Z, promoted to prod at 15:05Z. Also ran a migration to tag existing keys with their recorded version to avoid accidental collisions.
QA Jenkins: Added integration test that simulates model swap and asserts no cross-version prefix reuse. Test id: KV-INT-113
Ellen Park: Alerts and detection: added metric kv_cache_cross_version_count and an alert RULE-1120 that fires when a customer records >2 mismatched kv hits in 2 minutes.
Ravi Desai: Longer-term: we will add a deploy pipeline step that invalidates prefixes when a model changes architecture or major version (DEPLOY-204). Also evaluate TTL on prefix keys (suggest 24hr default) so old prefixes don't persist.
Ellen Park: Support comms: opened ticket SC-44122 to communicate to acct_430, included remediation steps and offer to review any billing/legal artifacts impacted.
support-bot: linked INC-2026-7867 to SC-44122
Ellen Park: Action items recap: ENG-RUNTIME PR-4891 merged & deployed, ENG-PLATFORM DEPLOY-204 in progress, SRE added RULE-1120 alert, QA added KV-INT-113 integration test, SUPPORT handling customer comms (SC-44122).
deploy-bot: Deploy gptx-versa:v4.0 -> promoted at 2026-03-18T15:05:00Z
Ellen Park: Postmortem will be drafted and linked in 48h. Closing thread; reopen if more mismatches surface. :thumbsup:
